text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having been invited to a Mejiro family

get-together, I arrive with Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks busy exchanging pleasantries
with all
her relatives, so I decide to
indulge in some
refreshments alone.
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What? ...You can't be serious?! Wait,
wait, when
did you get here?! Wooow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've never heard her let out such a joyous
cry
before. Just as I'm about to ask
what's
happened...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Dober's over the moon! You don't see
that every
day!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You might have heard about her
already, but
she's like a second mother
to Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Right after Dober was born, her mother
entered a
really busy period in her
modeling career...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That lady over there took care of Dober

whenever her mother was away. I hear
that she
often used to take Dober out
on fun trips.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Auntie! This food is really scrumptious!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I tell you? The food here is the
best! I used
to come here with your
mother fairly often.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
We'd always eat way too much, and then
go for a
run together! It was like a little
custom we had!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Mother did that? Then I want to run
with you,
too, Auntie!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
That sounds fun. But you have to finish
all of your
lunch first!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...That's pretty much how they were.
Dober's
really attached to her, since
they were always so
close.

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text: It's good to see you again, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you should have told me you were

attending. I would have dressed more
nicely!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I think you look plenty cute as
you are.
How have you been lately? I
want to hear all
about your academy life!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course! Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I may have told you this before, but my

roommate is from America!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's cheerful and daring, but you can't
leave her
alone for too long, as she's
always stirring up
some kind of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
On one occasion, she invited me to a
barbecue
but was so fixated on the meat
that she forgot to
bring any coals to
cook with.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
We had to run to the store to buy some.
She's
always got me dashing about on
crazy errands
like that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Although I won't deny that it can be
quite fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What else...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's a person who really cares a
lot for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This person always works really late and
never
listens when I tell them to rest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And even when they're exhausted, they
worry
about me instead. A bit of a
weirdo, right? Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to this person that I have
peace of
mind about certain things...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
M-moving on! The academy is really
great, and
every day is a blast!

text_block_list.name: Dober's Aunt
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it certainly sounds that way. I can
see the
sparkle in your eyes as you talk
about it. You're
just as cute as when you
were a child.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Well, what do you expect? I'm
always
delighted when we get the
chance to talk.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer? I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Heh! Didn't expect any less from Dober's
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I make my promise, the festivities end,
and we
head home...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did something good happen?
You've got a
goofy look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how come you look so happy? Did

something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Of all the things to get excited about...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see. I hope you filled your
belly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But what else did you expect? The
Mejiro family
cooks are on par with
those of high-class
restaurants.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The family cooks are on a whole
different level
from what you'd get
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More importantly... I'm rather impressed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More importantly... I'm rather impressed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Despite being among all those famous
Mejiro
folk, your appetite still managed
to overpower
your nerves. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober thinks I'm a glutton now,
but at
least I managed to keep my
promise to Mejiro
Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I didn't ask whether you saw
anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I didn't ask whether you saw
anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. I-It couldn't be... You mean you
saw....

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's nothing! Forget it! If you saw
nothing,
then it's fine. This conversation
is over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I feel a slight pang of guilt, but at least I

managed to keep my promise to Mejiro
Ryan.
